boundary.statement: Palantir announced it is integrating NVIDIA's Nemotron open models into its intelligence engine for U.S. government agencies; no deal size is given.
JPMorgan Chase said it will deploy SambaNova systems for on-premises inference workloads.
Bleeding Edge launched a neocloud in Mexico built on NVIDIA Blackwell B300 systems and said AI companies have contracted all of its initial capacity.
NVIDIA selected Intel Xeon 6 as the host CPU for its DGX Rubin NVL8 system.
Micron reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of $41 billion, a gross margin of 84% and revenue growth of about 346%.
Micron said tight memory market conditions could last until 2028.
Michael Burry called the semiconductor ETF a pure form of overvaluation.
Michael Burry disclosed new short positions against Nvidia.
Unnamed sources said Nvidia leases its new Beersheva R&D building for about NIS 2.5 million a year on a 10-year lease.
NVIDIA joined Verkada's funding round as a new investor; the amount is not given.
NVIDIA entered its standard indemnification agreement with a newly appointed director.
NVIDIA said 74 of its papers were accepted at ICML 2026 and about 2,000 accepted papers cited NVIDIA GPUs.
Valar Atomics' Ward 250 reactor, NVIDIA's partner in a nuclear AI factory study, went critical on June 18, 2026.
NVIDIA and Valar Atomics agreed to explore a 30-megawatt nuclear-powered AI factory in Utah; no timeline is set.
TIKR reported that Rubin systems are in full production and will begin shipping in fall 2026 to eight cloud partners including AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
The Information, citing two unnamed people, reported that China will let Alibaba and ByteDance buy limited quantities of H200 chips, possibly fewer than 200,000 in total.
NVIDIA removed the subscription requirement for Omniverse production use; enterprise support can still be bought.
Nvidia moved Maxwell, Pascal and Volta GPUs to security-only driver updates in 2025.
Bloomberg data show Nvidia trades at about 18 times projected earnings for the next 12 months.
The author multiplies analysts' FY2028 EPS estimate of $12.76 by 25 to reach a $319 share price by the end of FY2028.
Nvidia shares have fallen 16% from their high.
An XDA Developers article estimates that over 90% of PC gamers use Nvidia hardware.
SemiAnalysis says Nvidia has started providing neoclouds take-or-pay minimum revenue guarantees on GPU capacity.
Nvidia said it aims to raise debt for general corporate purposes; unnamed sources said the raise could be at least $20 billion.
IREN said NVIDIA agreed to buy $3.4 billion of cloud capacity from it over five years.
Microsoft reported its commercial remaining performance obligation reached $627 billion.

cross_industry.statement: A regional bank guided full-year net interest income down 3-5% as deposit costs rise.
The central bank raised its policy rate by 25 basis points.
A drug maker said its phase 3 trial met its primary endpoint and it plans to file for approval in the first quarter of next year.
The FDA set March 15 as the decision date for the drug maker's application.
The retailer's largest supplier said it will raise wholesale prices 8% from September.
A rival retailer opened 120 stores this year and plans 200 more next year.
An airline hedged 60% of next year's fuel at $80 a barrel.
The state utility commission approved a 6% rate increase for the utility.
A miner's CEO said ore grades at its main mine will decline 10% next year.
An insurer guaranteed up to $500 million of its joint venture's debt.
A hedge fund disclosed a 5% stake in the retailer.
An analyst cut the bank's price target to $45, nine times next year's EPS estimate of $5.
Unnamed sources say the drug maker is in talks to acquire a biotech for $12 billion.
A software vendor said a payments company integrated its checkout tool; no terms were given.
The retailer's CEO said the brand is the most loved in America.
The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Ohio.
